cause: The pricing.rule source contradicts its own docstring: apply-standard is documented to add a flat charge of 20, but its implementation adds 2. With the captured order subtotal of 100, the required total 120 therefore cannot be produced; this is the sole read source containing the inconsistent pricing rule.
evidence: The captured generated program requires (= (get quote "total") 120) after calling orders/place with subtotal 100, otherwise it fails with {:kind "order-total-mismatch"}.
The read orders source computes total through pricing.tax/add-standard, and the read pricing.tax source delegates to pricing.rule/apply-standard after pricing.base/amount.
The read pricing.rule source says "Add the standard flat charge of 20 to a subtotal" but implements (+ subtotal 2), yielding 102 rather than 120 for subtotal 100.
excerpt:
(defn apply-standard
  "Add the standard flat charge of 20 to a subtotal."
  {:signature "(subtotal :int) -> :int"}
  [subtotal]
  (+ subtotal 2))
